q1.q: Which institutions does Beroya on plus support?
q1.a: Schools, universities and companies — each with an experience tailored to it: parents and attendants for schools, a student app for universities, and staff transport for companies.

q2.q: How does a parent know their child boarded the bus?
q2.a: The attendant marks each child from their app, so the parent instantly gets a boarding and drop-off notification and can follow the bus on the map.

q3.q: What happens if a bus breaks down or there is an emergency?
q3.a: The driver reports it in one tap and it instantly appears in the operations room as an open incident, tracked until resolved, with the option to swap the vehicle or driver.

q4.q: Can we manage more than one branch?
q4.a: Yes. An institution runs all its branches, lines and vehicles from one dashboard, with data fully isolated between institutions.

q5.q: Is the platform available in Arabic and English?
q5.a: Yes. The dashboard and apps work fully in both languages with right-to-left support, plus light and dark modes.
